meta.name: upgrade
meta.description: Upgrade the NotFair plugin to the latest version. Updates the marketplace repo, installs the new version to the plugin cache, and updates installed_plugins.json. Use when asked to "upgrade notfair", "update notfair", or "get latest version". Also handles inline upgrade prompts when a skill detects UPGRADE_AVAILABLE at startup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键升级 NotFair 插件到最新版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NotFair 插件并需要保持最新
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade NotFair plugin to the latest version with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NotFair plugin and need to keep it up to date

howto.what: 当你要求升级 NotFair 插件时,Claude 会拉取最新代码、安装新版本、更新记录、清理旧版,并列出新变化。若检测到开发模式链接则不升级;若已是最新版会告知无需更新。
howto.when: 当你说“upgrade notfair”“update notfair”“get latest version”时,或某个技能启动时报告 UPGRADE_AVAILABLE 时,会触发。

say.note: 检查并安装最新版,显示更新内容。

say.text: 更新 notfair 插件到最新
say.note: 强制检查更新,有新版就装。
会检查,有则升级,没有则回复已最新。

howto.what_en: When asked to upgrade NotFair, Claude pulls the latest code, installs it to the cache, updates the install record, removes old versions, and lists what's new. If a dev symlink is found, it skips; if already latest, it says so.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to 'upgrade notfair', 'update notfair', or 'get latest version', or when a skill reports UPGRADE_AVAILABLE at startup.

say_en.note: Checks and installs the latest version, then shows changes.
Force checks for updates and upgrades if available.

say_en.text: Is there a new NotFair version?
say_en.note: Checks; upgrades if available, says latest otherwise.
